findings.description: William W Sloan had a wife named Maria, the mother of a son Thomas John Sloane (born about 1861), who married Maggie A Mahaffey in Toronto on 4 February 1891.

target_person.name: Maria Sloane
target_person.role: named as the groom's mother on the 1891 Toronto marriage registration of Thomas John Sloane

details.child: Thomas John Sloane, aged 30 in February 1891

supporting_sources: Canada, Ontario, Marriages, 1869-1927 — marriage of Thomas John Sloane, aged 30, and Maggie A Mahaffey, Toronto, York, Ontario, 4 Feb 1891, naming the groom's parents as William and Maria Sloane and the bride's as John and Jane Mahaffey
